capabilities: Add a copy button next to markdown links, bare URLs, and wikilinks
Copy image targets from rendered embeds and markdown images
Work in editing/Live Preview and reading view
Show buttons only while holding Ctrl, Cmd, Alt, or Shift
Match light and dark themes via Obsidian theme variables
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Copying a link target in Obsidian requires opening or selecting the link; there is no built-in one-click copy affordance like the one next to code blocks.
summary: Link copy helper that adds a one-click copy button next to markdown links, bare URLs, wikilinks, and rendered images.
